errors.evidence: The description incorrectly states that the bar for China/continental in 2013 is gray, but it is orange in the chart.
The description does not explicitly state that the chart illustrates vineyard areas in thousands of hectares for different countries over the period 2013–2022.
The description does not mention that Spain consistently has the highest values (around 950 thousand hectares) and Argentina the lowest (around 200 thousand hectares), with no changes over the years.
